faqs.question: What service options are available through the Transform Your Look with Haircut and Color Options deal at Mermaid Beauty?
faqs.answer: There are four options available: a Root Touchup Single Process with Deep Conditioning, Blowout, and Style; a Haircut with Single Process Root Touchup and Blowout/Style; a Haircut with Single-Process Color and Blowout/Style; and a Single Process with Deep Conditioning and Blowout/Style.

faqs.question: Where is Mermaid Beauty located in New York, NY?
faqs.answer: Mermaid Beauty is located at 12 West 48th Street, New York, NY 10036.

faqs.question: Does the Transform Your Look with Haircut and Color Options deal include a blowout or style finish?
faqs.answer: All four available options include a blowout or style as part of the service, ensuring a finished look regardless of which option is selected.

faqs.question: Which options at Mermaid Beauty include a haircut?
faqs.answer: Two of the four options include a haircut: the Haircut with Single Process Root Touchup and Blowout/Style, and the Haircut with Single-Process Color and Blowout/Style.

faqs.question: Is deep conditioning included in any of the Transform Your Look with Haircut and Color Options services?
faqs.answer: Deep conditioning is included in two of the available options: the Root Touchup Single Process with Deep Conditioning, Blowout, and Style, and the Single Process with Deep Conditioning and Blowout/Style.
